scope: literal exact input structure; not proof of measured behavioral effect
definition: assistant JSON opener directly followed by a new User event without a body or closing fence; distinct from final intended generation prefix
mechanism: candidate rollback restores generation-ready input checkpoint; append renders a new user event and assistant opener without retiring the prior pending opener
next_test: failed candidate versus committed response; repeated errors; multiple pending events; both native State and prompt replay. No unconditional repair by event type, since some rejection notices follow committed outputs.
